title: Three ways around a waltz
work: Waltz in D♭ major, Op. 64 No. 1
question: How do three pianists redistribute time between the running outer music and the broader middle?
intro: Rachmaninoff recorded the waltz for Victor on 5 April 1923; Muriel Nguyen Xuan’s recording is dated 2007 and Olga Gurevich’s approximately 2014. The files include different amounts of final decay and silence, so the alignment trims their tails rather than treating file length as playing time. Listen for where the running surface relaxes, then resumes.
